reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  -- one row per order placed in March 2025 (UTC days of order_ts): its units and revenue, added up before any join
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00')
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(t.units) AS units, SUM(t.revenue) AS revenue
FROM order_totals t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
GROUP BY o.channel

SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(l.quantity) AS units, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY o.channel

WITH march_orders AS (
  -- one row per order placed in March 2025 (UTC): only the columns the report needs
  SELECT order_id, channel
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
), order_totals AS (
  -- one row per such order: its units and revenue
  SELECT m.order_id, m.channel, SUM(l.quantity) AS units, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM march_orders m
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = m.order_id
  GROUP BY m.order_id, m.channel
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY channel

other_way.sql:
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(l.quantity) AS units, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY o.channel
other_way.tradeoff: Joining first and counting distinct orders gives the same numbers, but every line travels through the join before it is added up.

solver.query:
WITH ou AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.channel, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS units,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur), 0) AS rev
  FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(rev) AS revenue
FROM ou GROUP BY channel
